questions.question: Which animal is known for changing its skin color to blend into its surroundings?
questions.hint: Chameleons change their color for camouflage, communication, and temperature regulation.

questions.question: Which tree is famous for producing acorns?
questions.hint: Oak trees produce acorns, which are an important food source for many animals.

questions.question: Which toy cowboy is the main character in Toy Story?
questions.hint: Woody is Andy's favorite cowboy toy and the main character throughout the Toy Story series.

questions.question: Which superhero carries a shield made of Vibranium?
questions.hint: Captain America's shield is one of the strongest defensive weapons in the Marvel Universe.

questions.question: Which side of the road do people drive on in the United Kingdom?
questions.hint: The UK follows left-hand traffic, unlike most countries.

questions.question: Which emergency service provides medical assistance?
questions.hint: Ambulance services transport injured or sick people to hospitals and provide emergency medical care.

questions.question: Which city was buried after the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in AD 79?
questions.hint: Pompeii was preserved under volcanic ash, giving historians valuable insights into Roman life.

questions.question: Which famous queen ruled ancient Egypt?
questions.hint: Cleopatra VII was the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt.

questions.question: Which sport is played on ice using sticks and a puck?
questions.hint: Ice hockey is played on an ice rink where players try to score goals using a puck.

questions.question: In which sport is the term 'birdie' commonly used?
questions.hint: A birdie means completing a golf hole one stroke under par.

questions.question: Which country is home to the Great Barrier Reef?
questions.hint: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system and lies off Australia's northeast coast.

questions.question: Which mountain range contains Mount Everest?
questions.hint: Mount Everest, the world's highest mountain, is part of the Himalayan mountain range.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
questions.hint: About 78% of Earth's atmosphere is made up of nitrogen.

questions.question: Which planet is famous for its beautiful rings?
questions.hint: Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice and rock particles and are visible even through small telescopes.

questions.question: Which country is famous for the traditional dish paella?
questions.hint: Paella is a rice dish that originated in the Valencia region of Spain.

questions.question: Which instrument is commonly associated with Scotland?
questions.hint: Bagpipes are one of Scotland's most recognizable traditional musical instruments.

questions.question: Which bird is the largest living bird on Earth?
questions.hint: The ostrich is the world's largest bird and cannot fly, but it can run very fast.

questions.question: Which country has the most islands in the world?
questions.hint: Sweden has over 260,000 islands, more than any other country.

questions.question: Which blood cells help fight infections?
questions.hint: White blood cells are a vital part of the immune system, helping the body fight bacteria and viruses.

questions.question: Which famous monument was originally built as a tomb for an emperor's wife?
questions.hint: The Taj Mahal in India was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
